levels.surface: عبد العزيز بن يحيى بن سعيد البصري
عبد الله بن عمرو بن سعيد البصري

notes: «وكان قارئا للكتب» describes عبد الله بن سليمان and is left out of the surface; the saying is his own first-person account of a book he read, so he is the last link
the long narrative after the chain is the saying; the speakers inside the story (the scholar, the angel) are not transmitters
